title: Quantum-Hydrodynamic Bell Spectator Campaign: Preregistered Tests on IBM Heron Superconducting Processors
description: Complete 5-phase preregistered experimental campaign testing whether closed-loop Gross-Pitaevskii fluid dynamics exhibit deviations from the Born rule or non-Markovian spectator correlations on 156-qubit IBM Heron r2 superconducting quantum processors (ibm_marrakesh and ibm_kingston). Contains complete raw execution counts, calibration snapshots, algorithmic transmon layout selectors, and exact sign-flip permutation tests.
